gen.title: Scope and Conditions of the Proclamation

cards.stem: Which areas were specifically excluded from the order despite being in the South?
options: parts of the Confederacy that had already come under Union control
northern cities that never allowed slavery
cards.quote: It also expressly exempted parts of the Confederacy that had already come under Union control.

cards.stem: What did the promised freedom ultimately rely on for enforcement?
options: a direct vote by Congress to approve each case
cards.quote: Most important, the freedom it promised depended upon Union military victory.

cards.stem: What new military role was announced for Black men after the order?
options: the acceptance of Black men into the Union Army and Navy
automatic granting of officer commissions to all volunteers
creation of a separate civilian labor corps only
cards.quote: Moreover, the Proclamation announced the acceptance of Black men into the Union Army and Navy, enabling the liberated to become liberators.
